_comment: Sasha's voice: curious, quick, playful. CTF slang.

select.speaker: player
select.text: If I were them, where would I hide? Let's go find out.

z0_intro_p.speaker: player
z0_intro_p.text: Tutorial level? Speedrun it. Kidding. Mostly.

z1_intro_p.speaker: player
z1_intro_p.text: Spoofed From line, I bet. Headers are the source code of email.

z1_o3_p.speaker: player
z1_o3_p.text: Two delivered, one quarantined. And Mira clicked. Of course she did.

z1_outro_p.speaker: player
z1_outro_p.text: Gate's locked. But that macro ran. Next level unlocked: what did it do?

z2_intro_p.speaker: player
z2_intro_p.text: Process trees are basically puzzle boxes. Let's crack this one.

z2_o2_p.speaker: player
z2_o2_p.text: Word launching PowerShell? Classic. Let's pull the thread.

z2_outro_p.speaker: player
z2_outro_p.text: updchk.exe phoning stat-sync.example. Pwned box, but we've got their number now.

z3_intro_p.speaker: player
z3_intro_p.text: If I wanted to survive a reboot, I'd fake a OneDrive key. Let's see if they did.

z3_outro_p.speaker: player
z3_outro_p.text: Task and Run key gone. Fake OneDrive? Nice try. GG.

z4_intro_p.speaker: player
z4_intro_p.text: LSASS is the treasure chest. 0x1FFFFF means somebody brought a crowbar.

z4_o6_p.speaker: player
z4_o6_p.text: t.brooks left his admin creds in memory. That's the real flag they were after.

z4_outro_p.speaker: player
z4_outro_p.text: Creds rotated, LSA Protection on. Their loot just expired.

z5_intro_p.speaker: player
z5_intro_p.text: Recon time. whoami is always the first question. Always.

z5_outro_p.speaker: player
z5_outro_p.text: Five servers answered the sweep. I know their next moves.

z6_intro_p.speaker: player
z6_intro_p.text: ADMIN$ plus a service is just PsExec with extra steps. Let's trace the hops.

z6_o6_p.speaker: player
z6_o6_p.text: Jump server to the vault. They're one door from the loot.

z6_outro_p.speaker: player
z6_outro_p.text: Bridges burned in one move. But the vault's still beaconing.

z7_intro_p.speaker: player
z7_intro_p.text: Beacons are just bad at hiding rhythm. Let's find the beat.

z7_o6_p.speaker: player
z7_o6_p.text: Hex in a TXT record: ledger_q3.7z. That's the flag they want.

z7_outro_p.speaker: player
z7_outro_p.text: Every channel sinkholed. Their C2 is talking to a wall.

z8_intro_p.speaker: player
z8_intro_p.text: Final boss. Everything we learned, all at once. Let's go.

z8_o4_p.speaker: player
z8_o4_p.text: Ransomware armed for 13:00? Not on my watch.

z8_flag_p.speaker: player
z8_flag_p.text: THAT'S THE FLAG. GG, VELVET LOCUST. GG.

z0_node_train.speaker: player
z0_node_train.text: Reading the manual. Don't tell anyone.

z1_node_mailgw.speaker: player
z1_node_mailgw.text: Received headers, bottom-up. Where'd you really come from?

z1_node_helpdesk.speaker: player
z1_node_helpdesk.text: 'The page stayed blank.' Yeah, that's the macro.

z1_node_sandbox.speaker: player
z1_node_sandbox.text: Detonate it somewhere safe. Love a sandbox.

z1_node_vendor.speaker: player
z1_node_vendor.text: Real vendor sends PDFs. Somebody didn't read the docs.

z2_node_ws0142.speaker: player
z2_node_ws0142.text: Patient zero. Let's see the alert.

z2_node_edr.speaker: player
z2_node_edr.text: Prevalence of one. Rare is suspicious.

z2_node_proxy.speaker: player
z2_node_proxy.text: PowerShell user agent fetching a .bin. Download cradle spotted.

z3_node_ws0142.speaker: player
z3_node_ws0142.text: Autoruns: where malware goes to sleep.

z3_node_sched.speaker: player
z3_node_sched.text: Author: a finance user. Runs as SYSTEM. Sus.

z3_node_hive.speaker: player
z3_node_hive.text: OneDriveSync in Roaming? Real OneDrive lives in Local. Busted.

z3_node_gpo.speaker: player
z3_node_gpo.text: Baseline diff, the hunter's best friend.

z4_node_sysmon.speaker: player
z4_node_sysmon.text: comsvcs.dll in the call trace. I know this trick.

z4_node_ws0142.speaker: player
z4_node_ws0142.text: A 50 MB file named lsass.dmp. Subtle.

z4_node_helpdesk.speaker: player
z4_node_helpdesk.text: An admin logged in to fix a printer. Oh no.

z4_node_hardening.speaker: player
z4_node_hardening.text: LSA Protection: OFF. There's the vuln.

z5_node_ueba.speaker: player
z5_node_ueba.text: Tom's account on a finance desk? Tom's in a meeting.

z5_node_dc.speaker: player
z5_node_dc.text: Querying Domain Admins. Someone's building a target list.

z5_node_netflow.speaker: player
z5_node_netflow.text: Eight hosts in 38 seconds. Speedy sweep.

z5_node_itops.speaker: player
z5_node_itops.text: Alibi check. Tom's calendar says budget meeting.

z6_node_jump.speaker: player
z6_node_jump.text: File server RDPing to the jump box? That's not a thing.

z6_node_netpol.speaker: player
z6_node_netpol.text: Allowed paths. Anything off-script is our trail.

z7_node_proxy.speaker: player
z7_node_proxy.text: Every 300 seconds, 512 bytes. That's a metronome, not a human.

z7_node_lab.speaker: player
z7_node_lab.text: Their config. Primary, fallback, emergency. I love a leaked config.

z8_node_lab.speaker: player
z8_node_lab.text: seal_key 0x5c. Saving that for the final flag.

z8_node_core.speaker: player
z8_node_core.text: XOR seal. My favorite kind of lock.
